title: Coox daabisiyyi saaku xagana cule
intro: Ayro tawqek naharal tibbale saaqoota, ekraaro cuumih bicsen. dadal le naggaarinna gaaboysoh gulguluh tan, uxih kulli caxâ baxa faxa marak yayxeereenimih fidga bicsen. subci, kullim celtam amixxige waytam, kee qasiir data luddittel yunkuttube inkih abaabisa marah.
clues: Nanu dadaltah tan caxaaxuwi arac naggosneeh, tet caxâ baxa inkih ninnih gaaboynuh xagana culle.
Nanu xiibneh iroh nawqem subci baacoytit essere ken ludda uxih xiinih.
Nanu ninni xiibittek baxsa lem nek yewqeh, Yalli faxek axce kal qayxiixah yan numih gar nek yewqeh.
Nanu too ayro baacoyti ni caxaaxuwih addat cule waam idnisnuh ittat tutuctot nawqe.
Nanu ninnih fayramisenno dudda luk kullim gaaboynam kee faxe gleaner exxa beyaanam waasnam.
Nanu ninni caxaaxuwih arac bar bar finqiteeh, gaaboysen innal dattooweh, nanu waasnem kee toobitneh inne.

options: Nanu Sabtih ayro tatrusneemih taagah damaaqe fan korneh sugne

outcome.answer: Ni caxaaxuwi arac inki bar finqiteeh, bar innah dattooweh cabe

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
